# Camera UX & Instant Display Requirements Quality Checklist: การแก้ไขรูปสินค้า

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality, clarity, and completeness for direct camera photo capture and real-time catalog display
**Created**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all necessary user journeys for camera capture (viewfinder, shutter, preview, retake, accept) fully documented? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK002 Are camera stream cleanup requirements explicitly defined when closing modal or accepting photo? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are camera permission denial and hardware-not-found fallback requirements documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, User Story 3]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for multiple camera switching (front/back facing)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [x] CHK005 Is the shutter button touch target quantified with minimum dimensions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Constitution §6.5]
- [x] CHK006 Is "instant display in list without reload" quantified with timing expectations and reactive state mechanism? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK007 Is the image cache-busting strategy clearly specified to prevent stale browser thumbnail rendering? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK008 Are requirements defined for network failure during image upload without loss of textual product edits? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for non-camera desktop environments? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements defined for preserving table page index and search/category filters during instant image update? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2 Scenario 3]

## Accessibility & Elderly-Friendly Standards

- [x] CHK011 Are all interactive touch targets specified to be at least 48x48px (and shutter >= 64x64px)? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-012, Constitution §6.5]
- [x] CHK012 Are visual feedback states (hover/active/pressed) and clear Thai error dialogs specified? [Accessibility, Spec §User Story 1 & 3]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001 - CHK012)
